besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before the second 'en', which joins two clauses (jy voel / jy wil).
besluite.rede: The first 'en' joins two adjectives and stays bare; the second joins clauses and takes the comma.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en tog' joining two clauses (jy gebruik / energie raak weg).
besluite.rede: Two full clauses, so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: 'gaan oor in jou hardloop' uses running as a noun and reads woodenly.
besluite.rede: The rewrite moves the meaning: it limits the claim to the times you run, though the paragraph means energy used all day, and it brings in 'beweging', which may be a term of art in the energy topic.

besluite.fout: 'gaan by jou uit in die lug' is unidiomatic and makes the reader stumble.
besluite.rede: 'gaan uit jou lyf die lug in' says the same thing in the same direction, out of you and into the air; 'lug' here means air as air.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before the second 'en', which joins two clauses (jy raak / jy moet).
besluite.rede: The first 'en' joins two adjectives and stays bare; the second joins clauses and takes the comma.

besluite.fout: In the 'dat' clause the verb comes before the phrase 'met die son se lig' instead of at the end.
besluite.rede: Putting the verb last is the standard written word order, and the meaning is unchanged.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses (water is / grond gee).
besluite.rede: Two full clauses, so the comma is required.

besluite.fout: 'eerste self' is unnatural word order.
besluite.rede: 'self eerste' is the natural order and keeps the meaning: the plant itself uses the food first.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses (ons noem / dit is).

besluite.rede: The particle swap changes the meaning: 'by jou in' says the energy comes into you, which the lesson relies on, while 'by jou uit' says only that it reaches you.
